FAR_TRANS.MARKETS.purpose: Stores reference data for financial markets and exchanges including trading schedules and geographic location.

FAR_TRANS.TRANSACTIONS.purpose: Stores all buy and sell transactions for financial assets executed by customers through various channels.

FAR_TRANS.CLOSE_PRICES.purpose: Stores the daily closing price for each financial asset identified by ISIN.
FAR_TRANS.CLOSE_PRICES.grain: one row per asset per day

FAR_TRANS.CUSTOMER_INFORMATION.purpose: Stores historical snapshots of customer profile attributes including risk level and investment capacity over time.
FAR_TRANS.CUSTOMER_INFORMATION.grain: one row per customer per profile change date
never_use_for: current state only queries without timestamp filtering

FAR_TRANS.V_CUSTOMER_CURRENT.purpose: Stores the current state of customer profiles including risk level, investment capacity, and customer type.

FAR_TRANS.LIMIT_PRICES.purpose: Stores minimum and maximum price points for each asset over a date range with calculated profitability.
FAR_TRANS.LIMIT_PRICES.grain: one row per asset (ISIN) with min/max price range

FAR_TRANS.ASSET_INFORMATION.purpose: Stores master data for financial assets including names, categories, market, sector, and industry classifications.
FAR_TRANS.ASSET_INFORMATION.grain: one row per asset (ISIN) per timestamp

FAR_TRANS.V_ASSET_CURRENT.purpose: Stores the current state of financial assets with their categorization, market assignment, and sector/industry classification.
FAR_TRANS.V_ASSET_CURRENT.grain: one row per asset (ISIN) at a point in time
